scope: Independent attempt to refute the full-domain factor-two EB comparison using marginal-feasible channel witnesses and unrestricted canonical-POVM support duals
overall_status: UNKNOWN: no legal counterexample found; exact variance-dual filter and equality controls derived

claims.exact_statement: For any positive dual Q with a chosen spectral decomposition Q=sum_i w_i |A_i><A_i| on traceless Hermitians with tau(A_i^2)=1, define beta(Q)=inf over pure psi of sum_i w_i Var_psi(A_i). Then Z=sum_i w_i A_i^2-beta(Q) I is feasible for the canonical pure-state moment dual and S_d(Q)<=Tr_HS(Q)-beta(Q). Consequently a legal channel with Tr_HS(Q(I-Phi))<beta(Q)/2 would be a strict full-EB counterexample after the exact full-domain canonical reduction.
assumptions: tau=Tr/d and the real Hermitian HS space
rank-one POVM moment formula with barycenter I/d
full-Hermitian-domain comparison and K=2 Phi-I fixes the identity
claims.status: internally derived exact dual-feasibility identity; no channel meeting the strict inequality was found
claims.novelty_boundary: A certificate template and counterexample filter only; it does not prove the universal inequality or refute it.
claims.costs: Closed-form variance infimum is still required for a concrete certificate; no acquisition, solver, or implementation cost claim.
claims.falsifier: An algebraic error in the pure-state variance inequality, canonical support normalization, or full-domain dual conversion invalidates the filter.

claims.exact_statement: For Q=I on the traceless Hermitian space, beta=d(d-1), S_d(Q)=d-1, and the universal symmetric 1-to-2 cloner marginal lambda=(d+2)/(2(d+1)) has Tr_HS(Q(I-Phi))=beta/2 and saturates the support inequality.
assumptions: standard universal symmetric qudit cloner marginal
claims.status: internally derived algebraic equality; formula identities checked symbolically and at d=2,...,12
claims.novelty_boundary: Universal cloning is standard prior art; this is only a normalization/equality control.
claims.costs: Symbolic rational identities; less than one second with Python 3 and SymPy 1.14; no measurements or acquisition.
claims.falsifier: Failure of traceless-basis completeness, the standard cloner parameter, or the displayed symbolic equalities.

claims.exact_statement: For r pairwise anticommuting Hermitian involutions A_i and Q=sum_i |A_i><A_i|, the unrestricted canonical support is exactly S_d(Q)=1 and beta(Q)=r-1. A counterexample from this frame would require sum_i <A_i,Phi(A_i)>_tau>(r+1)/2.
assumptions: A_i^2=I and A_i A_j=-A_j A_i for i neq j
claims.status: internally proved by the Clifford anticommutation identity and an eigenbasis POVM; known structured channel controls cover this frame family
claims.novelty_boundary: Support-side exactness and a threshold only; not a new result on Clifford-compatible channels or arbitrary Q.
claims.costs: Exact algebra; no solver, acquisition, or hardware cost.
claims.falsifier: A normalized pure state with sum_i <A_i>^2>1, or a failure of the eigenbasis PVM to attain 1.

open_gate: Find a rank-at-least-three positive dual Q with a global all-pure-state dual envelope and a legal marginal-feasible symmetric extension whose Q-Dirichlet energy is strictly below the variance-gap threshold; otherwise prove that every legal extension pays at least beta(Q)/2 or strengthen the moment dual.
